data.notes:
Award winning iXAfrica Data Centres in Nairobi, Kenya is East Africa’s First and Largest Hyper-scale Carrier-neutral, and the only AI-ready Data Centre serving the region as a digital habitat for cloud, colocation, and connectivity.

Creating the largest ecosystem in the region, iXAfrica provides world-class and highly resilient Data Centre infrastructure to create a vital part of the internet backbone of East Africa. Our Nairobi Campus NBOX1, has an overall design capacity of 22.5MW, and is the largest Data Centre project in the Greater East African region serving a total population of 300+ million people.
